P01.title: Overlapping parcels
P01.description: Two parcels cover the same ground.

P02.title: Gap between parcels
P02.description: A small hole between parcels that is not a road, water or other public land.

P03.title: Duplicate parcel ID
P03.description: More than one polygon carries the same parcel number.

P04.title: Missing required attribute
P04.description: A required field (parcel ID, owner, site address or similar) is empty.

P05.title: Sliver parcel
P05.description: A very thin polygon, usually left over from editing.

A01.title: Missing required attribute
A01.description: An NG911-required field (number, street, municipality, ESN or MSAG community) is empty.

A02.title: Outside its parcel
A02.description: The point does not fall inside the parcel its ParcelID points to.

A03.title: Outside every parcel
A03.description: The point does not fall in any tax parcel.

A04.title: Road link broken
A04.description: The road centerline ID on the point does not exist.

A05.title: Street name mismatch
A05.description: The point's street name differs from its linked road segment.

A06.title: Number outside road range
A06.description: The house number is outside the address range of its linked road segment.

A07.title: Wrong side of the road
A07.description: An odd number sits on the even side of the road, or the reverse.

A08.title: Far from its road
A08.description: The point is unusually far from its linked road segment.

A09.title: Duplicate address
A09.description: Two active points share the same full address and unit.

A10.title: Municipality mismatch
A10.description: The municipality on the point differs from the municipal boundary it sits in.

R01.title: Mixed parity range
R01.description: A side of the road range mixes odd and even numbers.

R02.title: Overlapping ranges
R02.description: Two segments of the same street in the same municipality claim overlapping numbers on the same side.

R03.title: Missing range
R03.description: A named road segment has no address range.
